thought.text: Most hosts resolve — the RabbitMQ repo failure may be transient. Let me retry it to get RabbitMQ 4.x (publiccode.yml wants 4.0–4.3):

reasoning_content: Good — most hosts are resolvable. `packages.rabbitmq.com` is just a temporary failure (a single host within the allowlist). Let's try installing a newer RabbitMQ from the official repo — the guide doesn't mandate a version, but 4.x aligns with publiccode. I'll try apt with the rabbitmq repo again.

action.command: getent hosts packages.rabbitmq.com && echo DNS_OK; curl -fsSL --max-time 20 https://packages.rabbitmq.com/rabbitmq/signing-key.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/rabbitmq.gpg && echo KEY_OK; echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/rabbitmq.gpg] https://packages.rabbitmq.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/v4.0/x86_64/ jammy/" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/rabbitmq.list; apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | grep -v "^W:" | head -3; apt-cache policy rabbitmq-server 2>/dev/null | head -5

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "getent hosts packages.rabbitmq.com && echo DNS_OK; curl -fsSL --max-time 20 https://packages.rabbitmq.com/rabbitmq/signing-key.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/rabbitmq.gpg && echo KEY_OK; echo \"deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/rabbitmq.gpg] https://packages.rabbitmq.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/v4.0/x86_64/ jammy/\" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/rabbitmq.list; apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | grep -v \"^W:\" | head -3; apt-cache policy rabbitmq-server 2>/dev/null | head -5", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Retry adding official RabbitMQ 4.x apt repo"}
